text:
josh_recruiter: Quick q — candidate in Germany accepted verbal. We're proposing Band 5E uplift (special infra creds) at €140k base + €15k sign-on. Start target 2026-05-04. Need comp approval and want benefits to align with payroll day 1 if possible. Any constraints on benefits eligibility / waiting periods? Also curious if sign-on should be pro-rated into first payroll or paid separately. cc @lisa_peopleops for routing :pray:

maria_hr: Congrats! For DE hires we typically have a 30-day benefits waiting period for healthcare admin enrollment (carrier onboarding). Payroll can technically start day 1. If you want active benefits coverage from day 1 we need to set the benefits effective date to the start of the month of hire or request an exception — exceptions require a business justification.

lisa_peopleops: Two things: 1) comp uplift > 10% above market band needs Comp Committee pre-approval. 2) sign-on payout: People Ops prefers single lump at first payroll for tax/reporting simplicity, but we can split (50/50) after 90 days if retention reason. Which do you want?

josh_recruiter: Need fast path — candidate is negotiating relocation and wants benefits active immediately because they have ongoing care. Can we ask Comp Committee for both band uplift and benefits exception? Timeline: comp committee meets Tue 2026-04-28. Is that too late for a 2026-05-04 start?

maria_hr: If we route as an exception request today and mark urgent, we can ask committee to triage early. Also note: for DE, certain benefits (e.g., statutory pension contributions) are tied to payroll and start automatically; voluntary benefits (private health top-up, commuter) require carrier setup. We can record a manual enrollment date to backfill once carrier processes.

lisa_peopleops: Please fill the Exception Approval template and tag me. I'll escalate to Comp Committee Chair. Template snippet below — paste into the request thread: 

```
Candidate: <name + candidate id>
Role: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Proposed Band/Comp: Band 5E — €140,000 base + €15,000 sign-on
Justification: exceptional infra experience + critical project ramp
Benefits exception: request active voluntary benefits from day 1 due to ongoing care
Payroll plan: first-payroll lump sign-on requested
Requested routing: expedited Comp Committee review (urgent)
Start date: 2026-05-04
Hiring manager: Alex
```

maria_hr: Also include local payroll contact (ADP_DE) and confirm tax withholding preference (monthly vs. annual gross). For EU hires we need passport + work auth docs before first payroll in some countries.

alex_engineer: Hiring manager here — can confirm business justification. Candidate is replacing a critical on-call lead; project timeline means we really need 05/04. Happy to present in committee if that helps.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: please attach candidate docs (ID, offer letter signed) and the compsheet. Missing docs will delay benefits enrollment.

josh_recruiter: I'll file the exception now with the template and tag @lisa_peopleops. Requesting lump sign-on at first payroll; will note medical urgency in justification. Thanks all — will update thread after filing. :thumbsup:
